title: Factually wrong to say Hindu law is based on Manusmriti: Solicitor General Tushar Mehta
description: Solicitor General of India Tushar Mehta on Saturday said that it was factually incorrect to claim that Hindu law was based on Manusmriti.He made the remarks while delivering an address titled Ancient Wisdom and Legal Intelligence at an event hosted by the Foundation for Innovation and Technology Transfer (FITT), Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, in collaboration with I’M Happiness Foundation and Kotak BizLabs.
